text: This isn't a new pattern invented for this platform — it's the exact GitHub Actions shape this path's own Git/CI-CD course already built, adapted here to Jaffle Shop's real dbt project and Snowflake instead of Postgres.
The workflow triggers on every pull request and push to main, checks out the repo, installs a pinned Python version, installs the Snowflake dbt adapter, and installs the project's own packages.

A fresh runner has no profiles.yml and no real password on disk, so the workflow generates one itself, every run, reading every connection value through env_var — nothing sensitive ever written as literal text.

Those env_var values are fed at run time by step-level env, reading from GitHub's own encrypted secrets. The actual build step runs dbt build, the same dependency-ordered, test-respecting command Chapter 4 already established.

Notice schema ci — a fourth, disposable schema, separate from dev and prod, using its own narrowly-scoped credential. Next: making this workflow a real gate, not just a report, by requiring it before any merge.
